cpu_hotplug: Dynamic CPUHP_BP_PREPARE_DYN callback with matching removal; online channel creation holds cpus_read_lock through publication.
lifetime: One balanced module ref per live channel, released after final buffer/channel kref; fops owner protects live file and VMAs; producer quiescence required before close/reset; remove callback must withdraw and drain new file opens.
mmap: Zero initial offset and exact alloc_size; fault offset remains within allocated page count, including split VMAs.
ring_layout: Unmodified current pinned kernel relay.h, relay data layout, ring accounting and callbacks.
